scope: Desktop Obsidian plugin: explicit workspace refresh and explicit append-only correction submission through the existing Python backend.
authorship: Independent test author received the public command/data protocol before reading any plugin or backend implementation.
entrypoint: addons/cairntir_obsidian/main.js; CommonJS require('obsidian'), module.exports Plugin subclass; no build dependency

manifest.drawers: list of drawer_id, source_identity canonical UUID, content_sha256, exact content, wing, room, layer, current, editable, supersedes_id, and vault-relative note

interface.eligibility: Active note path exactly matches one manifest entry.note; entry.current and entry.editable are true; entry.wing and manifest.wing match configured wing. Untracked, ambiguous, stale, read-only, wrong-wing, or malformed data cannot create a request.
interface.dialog: Modal + Setting.addTextArea starts with exact source content. The explicit Submit correction button is the only proposal-write action; cancel writes nothing.

report.results: file='cairntir-sync/outbox/<request_id>.json', status committed|rejected, optional receipt with matching request_id, optional receipt_written=false, optional error

interface.success: A correction is acknowledged saved only when report schema and wing are valid, matching result.file has status committed, and receipt.request_id matches the submitted request. Outbox creation, exit zero, unrelated committed results, or a missing/mismatched receipt never imply saved.
interface.partial_success: Matching committed result plus receipt_written=false means database saved but receipt persistence needs retry. Matching commit plus projection.status=error means saved but refresh failed. Surface the distinction and preserve a retry path.
interface.retry: Retain a queued correction on process, report, rejection, receipt, or projection errors. Retry sync using the same queued request, without silently deleting it or creating a duplicate proposal.

criteria.accept: Plugin loads without automatic sync, source writes, outbox writes, or arbitrary-note import. Both commands are registered; settings are required before any subprocess.
Explicit refresh uses exact argv with execFile, bounded timeout/buffer, hidden Windows process, configured CAIRNTIR_HOME/PYTHONUTF8, and no shell interpolation.
Only the exact current editable tracked note in the configured wing can open an actionable correction dialog; cancellation produces no write.

Submit writes one correctly identified outbox JSON with exact source identity/digest and verbatim edited content, then invokes the backend. Original note and manifest bytes remain unchanged by the plugin.
Only matching committed receipt authorizes saved feedback; malformed, wrong-wing, missing-receipt, mismatched-receipt, unrelated-file, rejected, and process-failure outcomes do not claim saved.
Error and partial-success paths preserve requests and provide truthful, actionable retry feedback. A retry does not mint another correction for the same pending submission.

Manifest/README identify a desktop-only plugin, required settings, explicit refresh and append-only correction workflow; no claim of automatic ingestion, in-place historical rewrite, or independent hidden-test custody.

verification.kind: Node mock Obsidian and child_process integration with disposable public synthetic vaults
verification.limits: Mock integration verifies plugin boundary semantics, not a native Obsidian UI session or backend persistence. Parent separately qualifies backend behavior.

budget.reserve: One complete independent acceptance pass after each permitted implementation state.
